title: Mansa Musa's pilgrimage to Mecca
summary: The ruler of Mali made the hajj with an enormous entourage; his lavish gifts of gold in Cairo are said to have lowered the value of gold in Egypt.
why: Showed the immense wealth of the Mali Empire at its peak.

notes.problem: Source hedges the Cairo gold effect ('said to') and dates the pilgrimage 1324-1325.
